text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final destination of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho.
The moment of the decisive battle is almost upon us!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Handkerchief, check. Tissues, check. All set!
Mejiro Dober...! Do your best...!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Please, God...! Let Dober-chan
be able to cross the finish line with a smile again...!

Mejiro Dober's concentration is incredible,
completely unfazed even as cheers echo around her...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...We've finally made it this far, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding.
You're always the one asking, so today's my turn."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding.
You're always the one asking, Trainer,
so today's my turn."

It was an honest feeling.
As a trainer, there has never been a single time I wasn't nervous sending a runner out to a race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So you felt that way too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So you've been feeling
nervous all this time too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I was so caught up in my own head...
I didn't even notice at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Too bad for you, though.
I won't give you the chance to get nervous."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll show you and everyone the grand culmination of my Triple Tiara run.
